metadata.description: Angular wrapper for NeuroUX Web Components, enabling smooth integration of the adaptive UI in Angular applications.
Svelte wrapper for NeuroUX Web Components, providing seamless use of adaptive UI elements inside Svelte and SvelteKit applications.
React wrapper for NeuroUX Web Components, providing seamless integration with the adaptive UI engine.
Next.js wrapper for NeuroUX Web Components, providing seamless integration with the adaptive UI engine for Next.js applications.
Vue wrapper for NeuroUX Web Components, enabling easy use of the adaptive UI across Vue applications.
Universal JavaScript loader and helpers for NeuroUX Web Components, enabling adaptive UI in any environment without frameworks.
Lightweight behavioral signal detectors that identify focus, overload, motion sensitivity, and interaction patterns for adaptive UI.
Framework-agnostic Web Components UI providing customizable accessibility and comfort tools for adaptive user experiences.
SCSS design tokens, themes, and utilities for building adaptive, neuro-friendly interfaces using the NeuroUX system.
Shared utility functions supporting the NeuroUX adaptive engine and UI components.
Universal adaptive UX engine that enables cognitive-friendly interface adjustments based on user interaction patterns.
Starts Webpack dev server in production mode
